---
title: "Overall survival with unrestricted follow-up — PH results"
subtitle: "Adjusted (fixed): hazard ratio and standardized survival curves"
format: html
---

- No RMST: follow-up is unrestricted.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(rstanarm)
library(survival)
library(mice)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(ggdist)
library(knitr)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "survival.R"))

results_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "04-unrestricted-follow-up", "results"
)
ph_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "ph")
curve_dir <- file.path(ph_dir, "survival-curves")
figure_dir <- file.path(ph_dir, "figures")
dir.create(curve_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$m_supporting)
n_draws <- 1000L

imputations <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "imputations.rds"))
```

## Standardized survival curves and hazard ratio

```{r}
#| label: posterior-draws
#| include: false

# Survival times are identical across imputations, so imputation 1 suffices.
observed <- complete(imputations, 1) |>
  mutate(tx_plot = group_factor(tx))
max_follow_up <- max(observed$survival_time_days_unrestricted, na.rm = TRUE)

ph_results <- map(indices, \(index) {
  model <- readRDS(
    file.path(ph_dir, "models", sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  )
  standardization_data <- complete(imputations, index) |>
    mutate(mgps = factor(mgps, levels = 0:2))

  curves <- posterior_standardized_survival_draws(
    model,
    standardization_data,
    horizon = max_follow_up,
    n_points = 200L,
    n_draws = n_draws,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + (index - 1) * 1000 + 800
  ) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    mutate(tx = as.integer(tx), imputation = index)

  write_parquet(
    curves,
    file.path(curve_dir, sprintf("survival-curves-%02d.parquet", index)),
    compression = "zstd"
  )

  # Survival exactly at day 365 (the curve grid above need not contain it),
  # with the same prediction seed so that the draws match the curves.
  survival_365 <- posterior_standardized_survival_draws(
    model,
    standardization_data,
    horizon = 365,
    n_points = 2L,
    n_draws = n_draws,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + (index - 1) * 1000 + 800
  ) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    filter(time == 365) |>
    mutate(tx = as.integer(tx), imputation = index)

  write_parquet(
    survival_365,
    file.path(curve_dir, sprintf("survival-365-%02d.parquet", index)),
    compression = "zstd"
  )

  coefficient_draws <- as.matrix(model, pars = "tx")
  set.seed(config$seeds$supporting + (index - 1) * 1000 + 850)
  selected_draws <- sample(seq_len(nrow(coefficient_draws)), n_draws)

  hazard_ratio <- tibble(
    imputation = index,
    draw = seq_len(n_draws),
    log_hazard_ratio = coefficient_draws[selected_draws, 1],
    hazard_ratio = exp(log_hazard_ratio)
  )

  write_parquet(
    hazard_ratio,
    file.path(curve_dir, sprintf("hazard-ratio-%02d.parquet", index)),
    compression = "zstd"
  )

  list(curves = curves, hazard_ratio = hazard_ratio)
})

pooled_curves <- map(ph_results, "curves") |> list_rbind()
pooled_hr <- map(ph_results, "hazard_ratio") |> list_rbind()
```

## Pooled summaries

```{r}
#| label: pooled-summaries
#| include: false

curve_summary <- pooled_curves |>
  summarise(
    median = median(survival),
    lower = quantile(survival, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    upper = quantile(survival, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    .by = c(tx, time)
  )

hr_summary <- pooled_hr |>
  summarise(
    median = median(hazard_ratio),
    ci_66_low = quantile(hazard_ratio, 0.17, names = FALSE),
    ci_66_high = quantile(hazard_ratio, 0.83, names = FALSE),
    ci_95_low = quantile(hazard_ratio, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    ci_95_high = quantile(hazard_ratio, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    probability_benefit = mean(hazard_ratio < 1),
    imputations = n_distinct(imputation),
    draws_per_imputation = n_draws
  )

write_parquet(
  curve_summary,
  file.path(ph_dir, "survival-curve-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  pooled_hr,
  file.path(ph_dir, "hazard-ratio-draws.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  hr_summary,
  file.path(ph_dir, "hazard-ratio-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-supporting-os-unrestricted-ph-hr
#| tbl-cap: "Pooled treatment hazard ratio from the unrestricted-follow-up PH model"
#| echo: false

kable(hr_summary, digits = 3)
```

## Figures

```{r}
#| label: build-plots
#| include: false

km_fit <- survfit2(
  Surv(survival_time_days_unrestricted, status_death_unrestricted) ~ tx_plot,
  data = observed,
  conf.type = "log-log"
)

survival_plot <- plot_km_model(km_fit, curve_summary, x_max = max_follow_up)

hr_plot <- plot_posterior(
  pooled_hr$hazard_ratio,
  x_label = "Hazard ratio, ctDNA versus usual care",
  reference = 1,
  log_scale = TRUE
)

save_figure(
  ggsurvfit_build(survival_plot),
  file.path(figure_dir, "kaplan-meier-vs-ph-model.png"),
  height = 6.5
)
save_figure(hr_plot, file.path(figure_dir, "hazard-ratio-posterior.png"))
```
